title: niobe cost --json
description: Every session a repository's store holds, with the tokens it spent and the money its backend reported. Nothing in it is an estimate: tokens no reported cost covers are counted, never priced. A field is added without moving schema_version; it moves when one changes meaning or goes away.

repository.description: The name of the repository the sessions ran in: its root directory's name.

sessions.description: Oldest first, as the store numbers them, narrowed by --last and --since.

id.description: The number `niobe --resume` and `niobe sessions` name the session by.

started_at.description: When its first event happened, RFC 3339 in UTC to the second.

billing.description: How the session was billed, by what the backend or the profile said: by use, on a flat-rate plan, each for part of it, or nothing said.

tokens.description: Every token the session spent, whatever it was billed by.

input.description: Input billed at the full rate.

cache_read.description: Input served from the prompt cache.

cache_write.description: Input written into the prompt cache.

cache_write_1h.description: Of cache_write, the tokens written to live an hour: a share of it, not added to total.

cache_write_unsplit.description: Of cache_write, the tokens in records that did not say how long they were bought for: neither lifetime, so cache_write_1h is a share of the rest.

models.description: The total, per model id as the backend reported it; the values add up to tokens.total.

cost.description: The money spent, or null on a plan and where nothing said how the session was billed: no money moved there that a backend reported as spent. On a session billed both ways it is the part billed by use.

reported_usd.description: The sum of the costs the backend reported, in USD; null where it reported none. A floor of the bill while complete is false.

complete.description: Whether every usage record is covered by a reported cost, so that reported_usd is the bill rather than a floor.

records.description: The usage records the backend reported.

records_uncovered.description: Of records, those no reported cost covers.

older_recording.description: Whether the floor may be lower than the bill only because the session was recorded before its records said what a reported cost covers.
